title: tunnelmind:agent_tools:v1 — Attestation Block period_summary
description: Validates the `period_summary` object of an ATAP v0.1 Attestation Block under the tunnelmind:agent_tools:v1 profile. Every field is a non-negative integer count over the block's events. No field resolves to a natural person (ATAP v0.1 §7.6).

events.description: Events in the period, per event type.

tool_outcomes.description: `tool_called` events in the period, per outcome.

total_tokens.description: Sum of input_tokens and output_tokens over the period's `model_called` events that report them.
